prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 75.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.9%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Move Sign In After Pet Selection', 'Add Pet Controls Quickstart Screen']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Add Custom Pet Preview Stage', 'Redesign Home Intro with Desktop Video Demo', 'Desktop Pet Spawn Live Status', 'Streamline Path Selection Headlines', 'Pet Generation Time Estimate and Progress', 'Split Screen Layout for Path Selection', 'Redesign Path Selection Spotlight Layout', 'Clarify Account Sync Benefits on Sign In', 'Add Desktop Workspace Spawn Hint', 'Choose Path Instant Setup Helper Hint', 'Waiting Screen Two-Column Layout with Animated Activity', 'Add Custom Creation Reassurance Copy', 'Redesign Photo Upload with Split Layout and Sample Gallery', 'Add Pet Interaction Sound Check Screen', 'Clarify Account Sync and Pet Protection Headline', 'Desktop Readiness Sound Notification on Waiting Screen']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Clarify Single-Account Pet Retention', 'Redesign Pick Friend Grid Layout', 'Interactive Desktop Controls Tour', 'Show Adoption Certificate Stamp & Badge', 'Redesign Pick Friend Stage Showcase', 'Desktop Overlay Verification Check Flow', 'Simplify Path Choice Headline and Body', 'Custom Photo Upload Quality Guidance', 'Starter Item Reward Badge on Home Intro', 'Defer Account Sign In to Final Step', 'Add Interactive Desktop Controls Cheat Sheet Screen', 'Interactive Pet Personality Selector Flow', 'Adoption Certificate Custom Naming Incentive', 'Sign In Existing Account Pet Recovery Headline', 'Choose Path Carousel Layout with Interactive Cards', 'First Day Desktop Toy Bonus Incentive', 'Redesign Story Screen with Interactive Mascot Welcome']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Adding a new screen at finish (finish, new_screen) was helpful, producing a win in 1 of 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), which won its single test, as well as for all other change categories with 1 test.
Copy changes on sign-in (sign_in, copy) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all non-winning tests.
Both winning tests (sign_in, reorder and finish, new_screen) were significantly underpredicted.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Desktop Control Overview Screen at Onboarding Finish
candidates.change: Add a new screen called new_pet_controls_guide right after home_intro that provides visual instructions on how to toggle, minimize, and command the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Addressing post-onboarding confusion around pet desktop controls (3 support emails) and leveraging lesson that new_screen at finish works well.

candidates.title: Redesign Pick Friend Screen with Carousel Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pick_friend adoption screen into a interactive carousel layout showcasing animated pet preview cards.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has low conversion (60.9%) and long decision times (median 89s / mean 1017s).

candidates.title: Move Sign In After Adoption Certificate Step
candidates.change: Move sign_in to appear after adoption_certificate so users pick and personalize their pet before signing in.
candidates.why: Reordering sign_in won its single past test, and delaying friction until after adoption commitment boosts overall completion (currently 21.9%).

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Spawn Readiness Test Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a interactive desktop readiness flow screen (new_desktop_spawn_test) during waiting to verify screen permissions and desktop overlay placement.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop / app failing to open, and 4 emails about desktop features misbehaving after setup.

candidates.title: Choose Path Checklist Layout with Fast Path Highlights
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a checklist style contrasting instant pick path versus custom pet creation path.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion or decision paralysis during initial path selection.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidelines Tip Component
candidates.change: Add a dedicated guidance hint component on upload_photos explaining ideal photo lighting and single-pet focus.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation fails or looks wrong, contributing to adoption step drop-off.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, single-subject photos with neutral backgrounds for the best 3D pet rendering result.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Welcome Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Add a starter reward badge component to the home_intro screen celebrating onboarding completion.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low (21.9%); visual reward incentives at finish drive user motivation to complete setup.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Pet Protection Badge Notification
candidates.change: Add a highlighted safety badge component to sign_in assuring users that signing in preserves existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing drop-off and friction at sign_in.

components.text: Signing in backs up your pet profile and retains existing companions safely.

candidates.title: Redesign Waiting Screen Split Layout with Animated Mascot Progress
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen layout into a split layout featuring an animated mascot previewing desktop pet behaviors while generation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; visual engagement during wait prevents drop-off.

candidates.title: Story Screen Mascot Welcome Copy Refresh
candidates.change: Update story screen copy to clearly describe how the desktop pet lives, walks, and reacts on top of work apps.
candidates.why: choose_path mean time (514s) indicates early user uncertainty about what a desktop pet app actually does.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience
story.body: Adopt an animated companion that lives on your desktop, plays alongside your daily apps, and keeps you company while you work.
